title: Anachronism - Research Software
description:
Research software package for transparent rule-based heuristic indicators on Spanish party communication on Twitter/X using documented ideology-related substrings.

The software measures operational pattern labels for H1 pragmatic-function patterns, H2 historical versus metaphorical/anachronistic cues, H3 surface density / vacuity markers, and informal-fallacy lexical pattern flags.

Scientific qualification: outputs are heuristic indicators only. They are not independently validated determinations of rhetorical fallacies, discursive anachronisms, or semantic vacuity. No gold-standard human validation for these constructs is included in this artifact.

Raw and processed tweet corpora are not redistributed. The package ships rules, synthetic examples, locked aggregate targets, and reproduction scripts.

Repository: https://github.com/cesar-andress/anachronism

Concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23930970. Version DOI for archived release v1.0.1: 10.5281/zenodo.23930971.
